name: sitting shoulders stretch on bench
description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.
